scope: P1_PREPARATORY_ONLY; isolated ActionRegistry input/output snapshot fidelity

defect.hypothesis: Validation of caller objects followed by JSON copy can skip sparse array slots or execute serialization/accessor hooks, so executed data differs from validated data.
defect.patch: Create one detached immutable data snapshot from own enumerable data descriptors, rejecting holes, extra/hidden/symbol fields, accessors, hooks, non-JSON values, cycles and excessive depth; validate and use the same snapshot for input and output.
defect.expected_observable_change: Malformed input is rejected before guard/execute without getter/toJSON invocation; malformed output is INVALID_OUTPUT and releases the lock; valid nested payload remains stable across await.

local_browser.observation: Pinned Playwright 1.56.1 available, Chromium 1194 and Headless Shell 1194 binaries absent by filesystem check; no unchanged launch/GPU retry.

scope_limits: No live scene, microphone, storage, network, native permissions or Android integration
Opaque trusted interaction context is not serialized or copied; session identity remains unchanged
Trusted registered handlers and JS runtime only; this is not a sandbox for malicious Proxy traps or handler code
Schema definitions retain their existing registration path; this slice covers handler payloads/results
P0/P1 complete acceptance and staging/device checks remain NOT_TESTED
